card.name: Punctuation inside lists of interacting substances
card.fires_on: Commas and the period in "e.g." inside lists of metal cations or acid-reducing drugs, and small words like "of" or "volume" just before gastric lavage or an antihistamine.

modes.label: Commas in cation lists
modes.description: A comma after a metal such as iron or magnesium in a list of antacids, cations or supplements that interact with a drug.

modes.label: After e.g. before a drug
modes.description: The period in "e.g." just before a named acid-reducing drug like famotidine.

modes.label: Words before lavage or charcoal
modes.description: A linking word or modifier in overdose-treatment text, just before gastric lavage, charcoal or an antihistamine.
modes.example: This should include large<< volume>> gastric lavage followed by activated charcoal.
